change: Same binary: maximum archive batch size two versus one, fixed four cut slots and unchanged durability/memory limits.

control.label: control
control.method: Same frozen binary, archive batch size two (control) versus one (candidate), control first. Four cut slots, 256-MiB byte budget and 4096-entry cap unchanged. Three pinned 1-vCPU/3-GiB nodes, 1500 three-voter groups, 500 leaders/1000 followers each; four SQL workers and 64 work reservations; 24 writers, two 180-second windows. Fresh persistent internal node data, unchanged external RustFS backing, cold VM per cohort. No timed retries. Exact 4500 replica/1500 archive verification, all errors retained. Shared-host compiler/VM CPU observations; no builds, profiling or preservation by this task during timing. All prior artifacts retained; closed evidence relocated/compressed before both cohorts.

candidate.label: candidate
candidate.method: Same frozen binary, archive batch size two (control) versus one (candidate), control first. Four cut slots, 256-MiB byte budget and 4096-entry cap unchanged. Three pinned 1-vCPU/3-GiB nodes, 1500 three-voter groups, 500 leaders/1000 followers each; four SQL workers and 64 work reservations; 24 writers, two 180-second windows. Fresh persistent internal node data, unchanged external RustFS backing, cold VM per cohort. No timed retries. Exact 4500 replica/1500 archive verification, all errors retained. Shared-host compiler/VM CPU observations; no builds, profiling or preservation by this task during timing. All prior artifacts retained; closed evidence relocated/compressed before both cohorts. Closed control Raft logs were transparently compressed and byte/metadata verified before the candidate to restore headroom; original volume paths/options remain. Fresh candidate storage is uncompressed. Closed historical evidence was preserved through verified compression and relocation before this observation. Fresh node and RustFS backing are unchanged.

method_limits: Control first; reversed confirmation remains outstanding.
Successful latencies exclude refused requests; any timed error fails qualification.
Operation durations overlap and are not additive client latency components.
Archive batches contain differing numbers of cuts; per-batch means alone do not compare publication throughput.
Boundary VM/cgroup counters differ in timing and cannot be exactly subtracted.
Coverage index distance includes protocol entries; boundary lag is not admission retained-entry count.
The same setting changes both coalescing and whole-batch completion dependency; this does not isolate a per-cut streaming implementation.
Closed control logs were losslessly compressed between cohorts to retain disk reserve, with original volume paths/options and logical contents verified; fresh candidate data was not compressed.
The control has 169 known overload replies but only 167 retained-entry refusals and failed staging observations; the other two replies are not attributed to that gate.
decision: Keep production batch-size default two. Singleton meets the 500-ms/zero-error gate in this pair but does not establish a throughput improvement; reversed confirmation is not claimed.
